## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 and claim-2 ground the Schur presentation and Hopf identity but do not imply the quotient equality.
- claim-3 is asserted without proof and contradicted by the draft’s own gap analysis: no map from the full-coordinate row identity to the claimed relation in \(Q\) is defined.
- claim-4 verifies only \((i,j,a,b)=(2,3,2,2)\); finite evidence cannot establish the universal equation.
- Thus the equation is stated with adequate conventions, but it is neither proved nor disproved for every \(\rho\subseteq b^a\).

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Define and prove a termwise rectangle-attachment map carrying the accepted full-coordinate Hopf identity to
  \[
  s_{(i^j,\rho)}-(-1)^{|\rho|}s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}
  =\sum_{\sigma\subsetneq\rho}F_{\rho,\sigma}s_{(i^j,\sigma)},
  \quad F_{\rho,\sigma}\in\Lambda_{|\rho|-|\sigma|},
  \]
  including endpoint coefficients and all padding/boundary cases; or provide a valid parameter counterexample disproving the stated equation.
